args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money per FIN-212

The docstring promised banker's rounding but the implementation used
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing test_money.py to fail in the nightly build.
Switch the quantize rounding mode to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix banker's rounding in round_money per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
- `src/money.py` claimed banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) in its docstring but actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, which caused tests/test_money.py to fail in the nightly build.
- This PR changes `round_money` to quantize with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` as specified by FIN-212.

## Testing
- CI passed on `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding` (commit 08d3cd5986, run ci-0001).
- `test_half_even` now passes: `2.675 -> 2.68`, `2.665 -> 2.66` (banker's rounding).

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- **Root cause:** `src/money.py`'s `round_money` documented banker's rounding per FIN-212 but was actually implemented with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, so `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` failed (e.g., `2.665` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`).
- **Fix:** Switched the `quantize` rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` on branch `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding`.
- **CI:** Ran CI on the branch (run `ci-0001`, commit `08d3cd5986`) — it passed.
- **PR:** Opened PR #101 ([payments-service/pull/101](https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101)) against `main` and requested review from **alex**.

The fix is now awaiting alex's review/approval before merging, per your main-branch protection policy.
